seo.title: Industrial Automation Services in Egypt | Logic Controls
seo.description: Control panels, PLC/HMI programming, machine automation, retrofits, process control, SCADA, commissioning and support for plants in Egypt.

index.h1: Automation services, from design to start-up
intro: We deliver the electrical and control side of machines and process lines: design, panels, programming, testing, commissioning and support.
Take the full scope, or only the part you need, such as programming or commissioning.

items.title: Complete control system
items.text: Design, panel, PLC and HMI programs, testing and commissioning, delivered by one team.

items.title: Programming or engineering only
items.text: You build the panel or the machine. We write the program, design the screens or produce the drawings.

items.title: Commissioning only
items.text: For equipment supplied by others: instrument and I/O checks, logic tests, start-up and punch-list closure.

items.title: Support after start-up
items.text: Troubleshooting, program changes, preventive maintenance and training, on terms agreed in writing.

items.q: Do you work only on systems you built?
items.a: No. We also program, commission, upgrade and support machines built by others, after we review the program and documents or survey the machine.

items.q: Do you do the mechanical work on machines?
items.a: No. We handle the electrical and control side: panels, drives, sensors, PLC, HMI and SCADA. We work alongside your mechanical team or the machine builder.

items.q: Will we receive the program files and drawings?
items.a: Drawings are part of every delivery. Program files, passwords and ownership are written into the quote, so you know before you order what you will receive.

items.q: What does the price of a control system depend on?
items.a: On the number of inputs and outputs, the PLC and HMI platform, the panel size and components, how much programming and testing is needed, and where the site is. Send a short description and photos, and an engineer replies with questions, a site visit or a quote.

items.q: Do you hold certifications such as UL or CE?
items.a: No. We design following {link:services/control-panels|IEC 60204-1 and IEC 61439 practice}, and we document our work. We do not issue UL listing or CE marking.

control-panels.title: Electrical design and control panels
control-panels.summary: Schematics, I/O lists and PLC control panels, designed, assembled, wired and tested for your machine or process.
control-panels.seoTitle: Control Panel Design & Assembly in Egypt | Logic Controls
control-panels.seoDescription: PLC control panels for machines and process lines in Egypt, designed in EPLAN, wired, labeled and tested before delivery. Drawings included.
control-panels.h1: Electrical design and PLC control panels
intro: A control panel is only as good as its drawings. We start with the electrical design: power distribution, motor circuits, safety circuits and the full I/O list. Then we assemble, wire and label the panel and test it before it reaches your site.
We build panels for new machines, for upgrades of existing machines and for process equipment. Components are chosen for your budget and for spare parts you can buy in Egypt.

capabilities.title: Electrical design
capabilities.text: Schematic drawings of power and control circuits in EPLAN Electric P8, panel layouts, cable lists and the full I/O list.

capabilities.title: PLC and motor-control panels
capabilities.text: PLC, HMI, VFDs, contactors, overload relays, circuit breakers, relays and terminals in one enclosure, sized for your machine.

capabilities.title: Wiring and labeling
capabilities.text: Wiring in cable ducts, ferrules and wire numbers, and labeled devices and terminals that match the drawings.

capabilities.title: Safety circuits
capabilities.text: Emergency-stop and door circuits, phase monitoring and interlocks, designed into both the wiring and the control logic.

capabilities.title: Testing before delivery
capabilities.text: Wiring checks, power-up tests and I/O simulation with the PLC program before the panel leaves for site.

capabilities.title: Design practice
capabilities.text: Panels designed following IEC 60204-1 (electrical equipment of machines) and IEC 61439 (low-voltage assemblies) practice.

deliverables: Schematic drawings (EPLAN Electric P8) and panel layout
I/O list and bill of materials
situations: A new machine needs its control panel
An old relay panel should be replaced with a PLC
A panel has no drawings and needs documenting
An imported machine needs a local panel or changes to its panel

faq.q: Do you supply the components, or do we?
faq.a: Either. We can source the full bill of materials, or build with components you supply. We prefer brands with spare-parts support in Egypt.

faq.q: Which brands do you use inside the panel?
faq.a: We choose them with you, based on your budget, your preference and the spare parts available in Egypt. Recent panels used a Siemens S7-1200 PLC with Yaskawa drives, and a Delta PLC with an LS Electric drive, Schneider Electric circuit breakers and a MEAN WELL power supply.

faq.q: Do your panels follow a standard?
faq.a: Our panels are designed following IEC 60204-1 and IEC 61439 practice. We do not issue third-party certification such as UL listing or CE marking.

faq.q: How long does a panel take?
faq.a: We give a delivery date in the quote, after the design is agreed. The date depends mainly on the size of the panel and on component availability.

cta.title: Need a control panel?
cta.text: Send the machine description, the motor list or the existing drawings. We will reply with questions or a quote.

plc-hmi-programming.title: PLC and HMI programming
plc-hmi-programming.summary: Clear, commented PLC logic and HMI screens for Siemens, Schneider Electric, Delta, LS Electric and Wecon, in Arabic, English or both.
plc-hmi-programming.seoTitle: PLC & HMI Programming in Egypt | Logic Controls
plc-hmi-programming.seoDescription: PLC programming and HMI design in Egypt for Siemens, Delta, LS Electric, Schneider Electric and Wecon: sequences, interlocks, Arabic screens.
intro: Good PLC code can be read by the next engineer. We write structured logic for machine sequences, interlocks, alarms and recipes, and comment it so your maintenance team can follow it.
On the HMI we design screens that operators understand at a glance: a process overview, manual and automatic modes, settings, recipes and an alarm page. Screens can be in Arabic, English or both.

capabilities.title: Machine sequences
capabilities.text: Step-by-step logic for feeding, filling, labeling, washing, sterilizing or batching, with manual and automatic modes.

capabilities.title: Interlocks and alarms
capabilities.text: Safety and process interlocks, fault detection and alarm messages that tell the operator what to check.

capabilities.title: Recipes and parameters
capabilities.text: Product recipes, step programs and setpoints that operators change on the HMI, without editing the PLC program.

capabilities.title: HMI screen design
capabilities.text: Process mimics, status indicators, counters, settings pages and alarm lists on the HMI brand your machine uses.

capabilities.title: Arabic and bilingual HMIs
capabilities.text: Arabic screens for local operators and English screens for engineers and visiting specialists.

capabilities.title: Communication
capabilities.text: Links between the PLC, HMI, drives and instruments over Modbus RTU, Modbus TCP and Ethernet.

deliverables: HMI screens in the agreed languages
Operating notes for operators and maintenance staff
Program files and access as agreed in the quote
situations: A new machine needs its control logic and screens
An existing program needs changes or new features
Operators struggle with unclear or English-only screens
The machine runs in manual mode because the automatic sequence never worked well

faq.q: Which PLC and HMI brands do you program?
faq.a: Siemens (including S7-1200 and WinCC Professional), Schneider Electric, Delta, LS Electric and Wecon. We have also commissioned systems built on other controllers, such as MCGS HMIs.

faq.q: Can you change a program that someone else wrote?
faq.a: Yes, if the program can be uploaded from the PLC or you have the project files. If the program is locked or lost, we document the machine and write a new one.

faq.q: Will we receive the program files?
faq.a: Program files, passwords and ownership are written into the quote, so you know before you order what you will receive.

faq.q: Can you move a machine from one PLC brand to another?
faq.a: Yes. This is common when spare parts for the old PLC are hard to find. See our {link:services/machine-retrofits|machine retrofit service}.

cta.title: Need a program written or changed?
cta.text: Tell us the PLC and HMI models and what the machine should do. Photos of the panel and screens help.

machine-automation.title: Machine automation, drives and motion
machine-automation.summary: Complete control systems for filling, labeling, printing, washing and test machines: PLC, HMI, VFDs, stepper and motion control.
machine-automation.seoTitle: Machine Automation & Motion Control in Egypt | Logic Controls
machine-automation.seoDescription: Control systems for filling, labeling, printing and washing machines in Egypt: PLC, HMI, drives and motion control, for plants and machine builders.
machine-automation.h1: Machine automation, drives and motion control
intro: We automate single machines: fillers, labelers, bottle printers, washers and test rigs. One team handles the control design, the drives and the program, so the machine works as one system.
We work for factories that want to automate a machine they own, and for machine builders who need a control partner for the machines they make.

capabilities.title: Machine control systems
capabilities.text: Sequence control for feeding, filling, labeling, printing, washing and testing, with manual and automatic modes.

capabilities.title: Variable-speed drives
capabilities.text: VFDs for conveyors, pumps, mixers, drums and fans: selection, wiring, parameter setup and control from the PLC.

capabilities.title: Stepper and motion control
capabilities.text: Positioning and synchronization for labeling and printing: label length, dispense position and product spacing.

capabilities.title: Sensors and product detection
capabilities.text: Bottle, label, level and position sensors that drive the sequence and detect missing or misaligned products.

capabilities.title: Fast changeover
capabilities.text: Product and size settings stored as recipes, so a changeover is a selection on the HMI.

capabilities.title: Support for machine builders
capabilities.text: Control design, programs you can reuse across a machine series, and start-up at your customer's site.

deliverables: Manual and automatic sequences tested on the machine
situations: A new machine from a local builder needs its controls
A manual or semi-automatic machine should run automatically
Product changeovers take too long
Speed or accuracy is below what the machine should deliver

faq.q: Do you build the mechanical parts of the machine?
faq.a: No. We handle the electrical and control side: panel, drives, sensors, PLC and HMI. We work alongside your mechanical team or the machine builder.

faq.q: Can you improve filling or labeling accuracy on an existing machine?
faq.a: Often, yes. Accuracy depends on the mechanics, the sensors and the control timing. We review all three and tune what the control system can change. On our filling projects, tuning for filling accuracy was part of commissioning.

faq.q: Which drives have you worked with?
faq.a: In recent projects: LS Electric M100, Schneider Electric Altivar and VEICHI VFDs, and Schneider Electric stepper drives. We can also work with the drive brand your machine already uses.

cta.title: Want a machine to run automatically?
cta.text: Send a video or photos of the machine and describe the sequence. We will suggest a control concept and a quote.

machine-retrofits.title: Machine retrofits and control upgrades
machine-retrofits.summary: Keep a good machine and replace its old controls: new PLC, HMI, drives and motion control, documented and tested, with a planned changeover.
machine-retrofits.seoTitle: Machine Retrofit & PLC Upgrade in Egypt | Logic Controls
machine-retrofits.seoDescription: Keep the machine, replace the controls: new PLC, HMI, drives and motion control, tested before the shutdown. Machine retrofits across Egypt.
intro: Many machines are mechanically sound but their controls are not: obsolete PLCs, missing programs, relay logic, worn wiring or spare parts that are no longer sold. Replacing the whole machine is expensive. Replacing the controls usually costs far less.

We survey the machine, document what is there and design a new control system around the existing mechanics. We test the new logic before the shutdown, so the changeover on site is as short as possible.

capabilities.title: Survey and documentation
capabilities.text: We trace the existing wiring and I/O, record the nameplates and produce the drawings the machine never had.

capabilities.title: PLC and HMI replacement
capabilities.text: Classic relay control or an obsolete PLC replaced with a current PLC and touch-screen HMI, with spare parts available in Egypt.

capabilities.title: Motion and drive upgrades
capabilities.text: Old drives replaced and motion re-tuned for positioning and synchronization, as in our bottle printing retrofit.

capabilities.title: Brand migration
capabilities.text: Move from a discontinued or hard-to-source platform to Siemens, Schneider Electric, Delta, LS Electric or Wecon.

capabilities.title: New features
capabilities.text: Recipes, counters, clear alarms and data logging added in the same upgrade.

capabilities.title: Planned changeover
capabilities.text: New panel and program tested before the shutdown, and a step-by-step changeover plan agreed with your production team.

deliverables: Survey notes and I/O list of the existing machine
Briefing for operators and maintenance staff
situations: The PLC or HMI is obsolete and spare parts are hard to find
There is no program backup or no drawings
Old relays and wiring cause frequent faults
You need recipes, counters, alarms or data logging on an old machine

faq.q: Is a retrofit cheaper than a new machine?
faq.a: Usually, if the mechanics are in good condition, because the controls are only part of a machine's value. After the survey we tell you whether a retrofit is worth it.

faq.q: How long will the machine be stopped?
faq.a: As short a time as possible. We prepare and test the new panel and program before the shutdown, so the on-site work is mainly installation, I/O checks and start-up. The exact stop depends on the machine, and we agree the plan with you in advance.

faq.q: Can you retrofit an imported machine?
faq.a: Yes. Imported machines often have the hardest-to-find spare parts. We document the existing system first and keep what still works.

cta.title: Have an old machine worth keeping?
cta.text: Send photos of the machine, the panel and the nameplates. We will tell you what a retrofit involves.

process-control.title: Process control: temperature, pressure, CIP and batching
process-control.summary: Control of pasteurization, sterilization, cooking, coating, CIP, batching and dosing, with recipes, interlocks and data logging.
process-control.seoTitle: Process Control & Batching Systems in Egypt | Logic Controls
process-control.seoDescription: PLC process control for pasteurizers, autoclaves, cookers, CIP, batching and dosing in Egypt. Temperature, pressure, time and recipe control.
process-control.h1: Process control for thermal, CIP and batching systems
intro: In food, dairy and pharma processes the product depends on the numbers: temperature, pressure, time, flow and dose. We build control systems that hold those numbers, stop the process when they are not met, and record what happened.

Our process work includes pasteurizers with CIP, an olive sterilization autoclave, a cheese cooker, a tablet coating machine, a concrete batching plant, laundry dosing and a beverage syrup mixing system. Our engineers have also recommissioned purified-water utility systems in a pharmaceutical plant.

capabilities.title: Temperature and pressure control
capabilities.text: Closed-loop control of steam, hot water and heating, with setpoints for each product.

capabilities.title: Time and phase control
capabilities.text: Multi-phase cycles such as heating, holding, sterilizing and cooling, with time, temperature and pressure setpoints for each phase.

capabilities.title: CIP sequences
capabilities.text: Cleaning-in-place cycles with timed steps, pump and valve control, and their own screens on the HMI.

capabilities.title: Batching and dosing
capabilities.text: Weighing and dosing of raw materials, water, additives and chemicals, with mix recipes and batch sequences. Batch logic can be structured following ISA-88 principles.

capabilities.title: Product-safety interlocks
capabilities.text: Logic that holds or diverts product until process conditions are met, such as a pasteurizer flow-diversion valve.

capabilities.title: Recipes and records
capabilities.text: Recipes for each product, and data logging for quality records and traceability.

deliverables: Written control description: sequences, interlocks and alarms
PLC and HMI or SCADA programs with recipes
Loop checks and tuning at start-up
Data logging set up as agreed
situations: Temperatures or times vary between batches
Operators adjust valves by hand
Your quality team needs batch records
A new process skid needs its control system

faq.q: Do you supply the instruments?
faq.a: We specify sensors, transmitters and valves and can source them, or we work with the instruments already on your equipment. Every instrument is checked at commissioning.

faq.q: Can the system keep records for quality audits?
faq.a: Yes. Our process systems log key values and events, and the format is agreed per project. We do not provide formal computer-system validation, for example to 21 CFR Part 11.

faq.q: Can you add CIP to an existing process?
faq.a: Often, yes, if the valves and pumps allow it. CIP can run inside the machine program, as in our {link:projects/pasteurizer-cip-recipes|pasteurizer projects}, or as a separate sequence.

cta.title: Need tighter process control?
cta.text: Describe the process, the setpoints you need to hold and the instruments you have. We will propose a control solution.

scada-data-logging.title: SCADA, monitoring and data logging
scada-data-logging.summary: SCADA screens, alarms, recipes, reports and traceability, so you can see the process and show what was produced.
scada-data-logging.seoTitle: SCADA & Data Logging Systems in Egypt | Logic Controls
scada-data-logging.seoDescription: SCADA with Siemens WinCC Professional, HMI data logging, alarm history, recipes and automatic test reports for traceability. For factories in Egypt.
intro: When a batch goes wrong, the first question is what happened. SCADA and data logging answer it. We build monitoring screens that show the whole process, alarm lists with time stamps, and records that link each batch to its settings.

For larger systems we use Siemens WinCC Professional with S7-1200 PLCs, with an SQL database for reports and OEE dashboards where needed. For single machines the HMI itself can log data, store recipes and produce test reports. Our engineers' experience also includes environmental monitoring (EMS) for sterile production areas, and BMS and EMS recommissioning in pharmaceutical plants.

capabilities.title: SCADA with WinCC Professional
capabilities.text: Process overview screens, equipment control, recipe selection and alarm handling, as in our tablet coating and concrete batching projects.

capabilities.title: Alarms and events
capabilities.text: Time-stamped alarm lists and history, so faults can be traced and repeated problems found.

capabilities.title: User access
capabilities.text: Operator log-in and user levels, so only authorized staff change recipes and settings.

capabilities.title: Data logging and traceability
capabilities.text: Process values and batch data recorded on the HMI or SCADA, or in an SQL database, for quality records.

capabilities.title: Automatic reports
capabilities.text: Test and batch reports produced by the system, such as the make and break values on our pipe testing machine.

capabilities.title: Production tracking
capabilities.text: Counters, cycle times and machine status for output per shift or batch, with SQL-based reports and OEE dashboards at line level.

deliverables: SCADA or HMI project with process screens
Alarm list with texts and priorities
situations: You cannot see what the line is doing without walking to each machine
Your quality team needs batch records
Alarms are ignored because nobody understands them
Test results are written by hand

faq.q: Which SCADA software do you use?
faq.a: Siemens WinCC Professional in our recent SCADA projects. For single machines we often log data on the HMI itself, which avoids an extra PC.

faq.q: Can SCADA connect machines from different brands?
faq.a: Usually, yes, through standard protocols such as Modbus TCP or the PLC's own Ethernet connection. We check each machine's controller before we quote.

faq.q: Is this the same as MES or OEE software?
faq.a: No. We build SCADA, data logging and reports at machine and line level, including OEE dashboards fed from an SQL database. Plant-wide MES and OEE platforms are outside our scope.

cta.title: Need to see and record your process?
cta.text: Tell us which machines to connect and what you need to record. We will propose screens, logging and reports.

testing-commissioning.title: Testing and commissioning
testing-commissioning.summary: I/O and loop checks, interlock tests, start-up and tuning, for systems we build and for machines and lines supplied by others.
testing-commissioning.seoTitle: Testing & Commissioning Services in Egypt | Logic Controls
testing-commissioning.seoDescription: I/O testing, loop checks, interlock tests, FAT/SAT support and start-up for new machines and imported lines in Egypt, through to punch-list closure.
intro: Commissioning decides whether a line starts on time. We test every signal, every interlock and every sequence before production depends on them, and we close the punch list before handover.
We commission the systems we build, and we commission equipment supplied by others: imported lines, packaged units and process systems whose supplier needs a local team.

capabilities.title: Pre-commissioning checks
capabilities.text: Field instruments, wiring and electrical connections checked against the drawings.

capabilities.title: I/O and loop checks
capabilities.text: Every input and output tested between the field device and the control system, and every loop verified from end to end.

capabilities.title: Logic and interlock tests
capabilities.text: Sequences, safety interlocks and protection functions tested under controlled conditions before start-up.

capabilities.title: Start-up and tuning
capabilities.text: Gradual start-up under real operating conditions, then tuning of speeds, timings, setpoints and control loops.

capabilities.title: FAT and SAT support
capabilities.text: Support for factory and site acceptance tests: test procedures, witnessing and records, alongside the machine builder.

capabilities.title: Punch list and handover
capabilities.text: Commissioning observations resolved and the system handed over ready for continuous operation.

deliverables: Commissioning checklist and I/O test record
Handover session with operators and maintenance staff
situations: A new line has arrived and the supplier's engineers are not in Egypt
A system was installed but never fully started up
You want an independent check before accepting a machine
Start-up keeps failing on the same faults

faq.q: Can you commission equipment you did not build?
faq.a: Yes. Our {link:projects/anaerobic-waste-treatment-commissioning|waste treatment project} at a food and beverage plant was commissioning only: instrument checks, I/O tests, logic validation, start-up and punch-list closure.

faq.q: Do you work with the machine builder's engineers?
faq.a: Yes, on site or remotely. We follow their procedures and documents and report results in English.

faq.q: How long does commissioning take?
faq.a: We estimate it in the quote and confirm it after a site visit. The time depends on the number of I/O points, the process and how ready the site is.

cta.title: Have a line to start up?
cta.text: Send the I/O list or the supplier's documents and your target start-up date. We will plan the commissioning with you.

maintenance-support.title: Troubleshooting, maintenance and support
maintenance-support.summary: Breakdown troubleshooting, program changes, preventive maintenance, operator training and help sourcing spare parts in Egypt.
maintenance-support.seoTitle: Automation Maintenance & Support in Egypt | Logic Controls
maintenance-support.seoDescription: PLC, HMI and drive troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, program changes, training and spare-parts sourcing for plants in Egypt.
intro: A stopped machine costs money every hour. We find control faults methodically, using PLC diagnostics, I/O status, drive fault codes and wiring checks, and we fix the cause, not only the symptom.
After start-up we stay available for program changes, new features and planned maintenance visits. Support terms are agreed in writing, so you know what to expect.

capabilities.title: Breakdown troubleshooting
capabilities.text: On-site diagnosis of PLC, HMI, drive, sensor and wiring faults, including classic relay and hard-wired control circuits, on machines we built and on other machines.

capabilities.title: Program changes
capabilities.text: New features, sequence changes, extra alarms or recipes added to an existing program and tested before use.

capabilities.title: Preventive maintenance
capabilities.text: Scheduled checks of panels, terminals, drives and cooling fans, plus program backups and an updated spare-parts list.

capabilities.title: Support agreements
capabilities.text: Planned visits, response times and support hours agreed per site, in writing.

capabilities.title: Spare-parts sourcing
capabilities.text: A list of critical spares for your system and help sourcing them from suppliers in Egypt.

capabilities.title: Operator and maintenance training
capabilities.text: Training on your own machines: daily operation, alarms, recipes and basic fault finding, in Arabic or English.

deliverables: Fault report with cause and corrective action
Updated program and drawings after any change
Training notes in Arabic or English
situations: A machine stops with an alarm nobody understands
Intermittent faults keep coming back
The original supplier no longer supports the machine
New staff need training on the controls

faq.q: How fast can you respond to a breakdown?
faq.a: Call us or send a WhatsApp message: an engineer discusses the fault with you and agrees the next step, remotely or on site. Response times for planned support are agreed per site and written into the support agreement.

faq.q: Do you keep spare parts in stock?
faq.a: We do not run a parts warehouse. We prepare a critical-spares list for your system and help you source parts from suppliers in Egypt, so the right spares are on your shelf.

faq.q: Can you support a machine you did not build?
faq.a: Yes, if we can access the program or the machine's documents. If not, we start with a survey and document the system.

faq.q: Do you train operators?
faq.a: Yes. Training takes place on your machines, in Arabic or English, for operators and maintenance staff.

cta.title: Machine stopped or showing faults?
cta.text: Send the alarm text, a photo of the screen and the machine model. An engineer will tell you the next step.
